adopted_model.role: neuromitosis model — local cognition for the human+robot+DAO bond
adopted_model.why: 4B Q4 fits 6 GB VRAM; vision projector available for robot/surface frames; already serves the aeboy

hard_boundary: GGUF is an inference format and CANNOT be fine-tuned. Training uses the safetensors base; the resulting LoRA adapter is applied back at serve time. The serving GGUF is never modified.

corpus.sources: ae_lessons.jsonl (39), tinyactor-takes (1), ae-boy identity (1), receipts (2), ae-policy.json (1)
corpus.secret_scan: 0 credential values; the word token appears only inside a lesson INVARIANT forbidding leaks

method: QLoRA 4-bit nf4 double-quant, r=8 alpha=16, grad-checkpointing, batch 1 accum 4, 2 epochs
not_claimed: a new authority — the adapter grants no acts and changes no policy
robot motion — nu=0 plants; no commanded act
a secret store — no credential is in corpus, adapter, or receipt
a new persona — identity is injected by the proxy at serve time, not memorised in weights
acceptance: corpus regenerates to the same sha256
aeboy still answers through the unmodified GGUF before and after
